column1: # Names players use for the parts of the ships the game doesn't name: the No Man's Sky Coordinate Exchange's
# (NMSCE), and this project's own for parts NMSCE has no name for. tools/build_community_part_names.py checks
# them against the parts tables and writes src/core/data/community-part-names.json from them.
# Each line is a model (its key in the parts tables), a name and the parts that make it, separated by tabs.
# The parts are alternatives, separated by commas: a part ID, or IDs joined by + that must all be on the ship.
# (A, B) + C stands for A + C, B + C. An alternative can end with "on" and IDs the ship must have as well, which
# aren't part of what the name is made of. "always" is a part every ship of the model has, with no ID of its own.
# A ship has every name one of whose alternatives it has, made of the parts of all such alternatives.
